{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1793115736988,"sessionID":"ses_e81fa3104ffecGGbezrHV3hGrm","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01LZ687k9u3KdM5pF2gMtsur","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/stencil3d_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r5/stencil3d/stencil3d.cpp","content":"#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nusing Real = double;\n\n// CUDA error checking: aborts the program on any CUDA runtime failure\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                        \\\n    do {                                                                        \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                              \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                              \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s (%s)\\n\", __FILE__,         \\\n                    __LINE__, cudaGetErrorString(err_), #call);                 \\\n            exit(1);                                                            \\\n        }                                                                       \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// 3D index calculation\n__host__ __device__ inline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {\n    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n}\n\n// Grid initialization on the device: grid[idx] = (idx % 19)\n__global__ void initGridKernel(Real* __restrict__ grid, const size_t gridSize) {\n    const size_t stride = (size_t)gridDim.x * blockDim.x;\n    for (size_t idx = (size_t)blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; idx < gridSize; idx += stride) {\n        grid[idx] = (Real)(idx % 19) * 1.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// 7-point stencil kernel, one thread per cell (grid-stride in y and z for\n// arbitrarily large grids). Boundary cells are copied, interior cells are\n// averaged. The summation order matches the original serial implementation,\n// so results are bitwise identical.\n__global__ void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,\n                              Real* __restrict__ output,\n                              const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {\n    const size_t x = (size_t)blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (x >= nx) return;\n\n    for (size_t z = blockIdx.z; z < nz; z += gridDim.z) {\n        const bool zBoundary = (z == 0 || z == nz - 1);\n        for (size_t y = (size_t)blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y; y < ny;\n             y += (size_t)gridDim.y * blockDim.y) {\n            const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n\n            if (zBoundary || x == 0 || x == nx - 1 || y == 0 || y == ny - 1) {\n                output[idx] = input[idx];\n            } else {\n                const size_t planeStride = nx * ny;\n                const Real center = input[idx];\n                const Real left = input[idx - 1];\n                const Real right = input[idx + 1];\n                const Real front = input[idx - nx];\n                const Real back = input[idx + nx];\n                const Real bottom = input[idx - planeStride];\n                const Real top = input[idx + planeStride];\n\n                // Simple averaging stencil\n                output[idx] = (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid initializeGrid(Real* d_grid, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {\n    const size_t gridSize = nx * ny * nz;\n    const unsigned int threads = 256;\n    size_t blocks = (gridSize + threads - 1) / threads;\n    if (blocks > 65535ull * 16) blocks = 65535ull * 16;  // grid-stride loop covers the rest\n    initGridKernel<<<(unsigned int)blocks, threads>>>(d_grid, gridSize);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\n// Launch one stencil iteration on the device\nvoid stencilIteration(const Real* d_input, Real* d_output,\n                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {\n    if (nx == 0 || ny == 0 || nz == 0) return;\n\n    const dim3 block(32, 8, 1);\n    const dim3 grid((unsigned int)((nx + block.x - 1) / block.x),\n                    (unsigned int)std::min<size_t>((ny + block.y - 1) / block.y, 65535),\n                    (unsigned int)std::min<size_t>(nz, 65535));\n    stencilKernel<<<grid, block>>>(d_input, d_output, nx, ny, nz);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<Real>& grid, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nx, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t ny, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nz) {\n    // Simple sanity checks\n    \n    // 1. No NaN or Inf values\n    for (const auto& val : grid) {\n        if (std::isnan(val) || std::isinf(val)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // 2. Values should be reasonable (bounded)\n    Real minVal = grid[0];\n    Real maxVal = grid[0];\n    for (const auto& val : grid) {\n        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);\n        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Value range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", minVal, maxVal);\n    \n    // After averaging, values should be somewhat bounded\n    if (maxVal > 1e6 || minVal < -1e6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: values out of expected range\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    // 3. Boundary values should not change significantly\n    // (they are copied, so they should be close to initial values)\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 128)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t nx = 128;\n    size_t ny = 0;  // Will be set to nx if not specified\n    size_t nz = 0;  // Will be set to nx if not specified\n    int iterations = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-x\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-y\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            ny = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-z\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nz = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;\n    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;\n    \n    printf(\"3D Stencil Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\\n\", nx, ny, nz);\n    printf(\"Iterations: %d\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    size_t gridSize = nx * ny * nz;\n    size_t gridBytes = gridSize * sizeof(Real);\n\n    // Verify a CUDA device is available (CUDA is mandatory)\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));\n    if (deviceCount == 0) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA-capable device found\\n\");\n        return 1;\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));\n    \n    // Allocate grids on the device (double buffering)\n    Real* d_grid1 = nullptr;\n    Real* d_grid2 = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_grid1, gridBytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_grid2, gridBytes));\n    \n    // Initialize\n    printf(\"Initializing grid...\\n\");\n    initializeGrid(d_grid1, nx, ny, nz);\n    // Zero the second buffer (matches the original zero-initialized vector)\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(d_grid2, 0, gridBytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    \n    // Run stencil iterations\n    printf(\"Running stencil computation...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        if (iter % 2 == 0) {\n            stencilIteration(d_grid1, d_grid2, nx, ny, nz);\n        } else {\n            stencilIteration(d_grid2, d_grid1, nx, ny, nz);\n        }\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate performance metrics\n    double cellUpdates = (double)((nx-2) * (ny-2) * (nz-2)) * iterations;\n    double mcups = cellUpdates / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e6;  // Million cell updates per second\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\\n\", mcups);\n    \n    // Copy the final grid back to the host only when it is needed\n    Real* d_finalGrid = (iterations % 2 == 0) ? d_grid1 : d_grid2;\n    if (printResults || validate) {\n        std::vector<Real> finalGrid(gridSize);\n        if (gridSize > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(finalGrid.data(), d_finalGrid, gridBytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        }\n\n        // Print results for external validation\n        if (printResults) {\n            print_results(finalGrid, \"Grid\");\n        }\n\n        // Validation\n        if (validate) {\n            printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n            bool valid = validateResult(finalGrid, nx, ny, nz);\n\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_grid1));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_grid2));\n\n            if (valid) {\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n                return 0;\n            } else {\n                printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n                return 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_grid1));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_grid2));\n    \n    return 0;\n}\n"},"output":"Wrote file
